subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should Gateway owners accept this PR's forced `process.exit(0)` watchdog, strict internal `/healthz?strict=1` semantics, and `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_POST_SHUTDOWN_EXIT_TIMEOUT_MS` env surface as the permanent supervised-recovery contract?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it intentionally changes process-lifetime and service-supervisor behavior that green CI cannot decide as product/operator policy.

options.title: Accept Current Contract
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks if owners accept the forced-exit timeout and strict internal probe as the preferred outage-recovery guard.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to remove or alter the env surface or timeout behavior while preserving the strict internal probe and zombie recovery coverage.

options.title: Pause For Restart Design
options.body: Hold this PR if owners want a broader supervisor/restart contract before introducing forced process exit.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Contract
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks if owners accept the forced-exit timeout and strict internal probe as the preferred outage-recovery guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the clearest current-main owner signal for the affected Gateway runtime files.
